reasoning: The matching completed project collected new MTurk samples to re-test 26 distinct published findings. The 41 candidates were only the decision-market pool; the 15 unselected papers were not replicated and are excluded. Each of the 26 primary post-replication reports identifies its target and states a final outcome, used independently for that target. Bibliographic entries are copied from the main paper’s reference list, including DOI identifiers present in its supplied PMC XML text. Study numbers are left empty where the replication report does not name a study number. Reanalyses of original data used to plan some replications are ancillary to this project’s focal new-data tests.
